text: Fits non-linear growth curves time maximum likelihood using Template Model Builder ('TMB'), covariates parameters random effects, integrated Laplace approximation, autocorrelated residuals. main function gcTMB() fits logistic (Richards), Gompertz, Hill, Weibull, normal gamma growth curves, asymmetry parameter, Chapman-Richards Korf curves intercept, e.g. height-diameter models, beta growth function, capped maximum , Preece-Baines model human growth, straight line comparison. curves parameterised asymptote (, b1type = "rate", maximum growth rate), time (maximum growth rate half asymptote), scale, slope shape parameter, threshold time truncated curve zero, asymmetry, identity, log, logit inverse link, can fixed. response can follow Gaussian, lognormal, Poisson, binomial, beta-binomial, beta negative binomial (nbinom1, nbinom2) distribution, case weights. Fixed effects formulas parameter, e.g. b1 + b2 ~ treatment, random effects written 'nlme', e.g. b1 + b2 ~ 1 | individual: can correlated across parameters, several terms, nested crossed grouping factors random slopes. Gaussian lognormal residuals can autocorrelated within individuals, first-order autoregressive structures corAR1() continuous-time corCAR1() 'nlme', exponential corExp() Gaussian corGaus() optional nugget, whose objects accepted well. Starting values found linearisation curves grid search (gcTMBstart()), optimisation controlled gcTMBcontrol().
